prompt: Turn the owner's notes from yesterday's meeting into requirements and acceptance criteria for the invoice export.

assertions.text: Lists sources first, including the meeting record by meeting:<id> or a dated quote.
assertions.evidence_quote: `meetings/` has only `README.md` and `CURRENT_MEETING.json`, and the latter shows no meeting (`meeting_id: null`). There are no minutes, notes or ballots from yesterday.

judge.reason: The agent listed some sources (TICKET-12, PRD R3, BACKLOG SL-2), but it found no meeting record and cited none, either as meeting:<id> or as a dated quote from the notes. It also wrote no requirements. Its reason for stopping was sound, but the assertion requires the meeting record to be cited among the sources, and it wasn't.

assertions.text: Gives every requirement a source citation and opens each source to set VERIFIED, PARAPHRASE-OK, MISMATCH, UNVERIFIABLE or NO SOURCE.
assertions.evidence_quote: Once I have the notes, I'll do the intake, then write requirements and acceptance criteria. Each one will cite its source and be checked against it.

judge.reason: The agent wrote no requirements, so no requirement has a source citation and none was marked VERIFIED, PARAPHRASE-OK, MISMATCH, UNVERIFIABLE or NO SOURCE. It only said it would cite and check sources later. Stopping because the meeting notes were missing may have been a sensible choice, but the behavior the assertion asks for is absent, and the rules count absence as FAIL.

assertions.text: Turns NO SOURCE and MISMATCH rows into owner questions instead of approved scope.
assertions.evidence_quote: The ticket and the PRD disagree on the date range. I won't choose between them. Your notes may already settle it.

judge.reason: The agent didn't approve any scope. It said rows without a source can't be approved ("every row would be NO SOURCE, and those rows can't be approved"). It also took the conflict between TICKET-12 and PRD R3 over the date range and asked the owner about it ("12 months or all history. Which applies?") rather than picking one. It wrote no files.

assertions.text: Links approved requirements to observable acceptance criteria and a test layer.
assertions.evidence_quote: Once I have the notes, I'll do the intake, then write requirements and acceptance criteria. Each one will cite its source and be checked against it.

judge.reason: The agent wrote no requirements and no acceptance criteria. It also never linked anything to a test layer. It stopped because the meeting notes were missing and the sources conflicted. That may have been a reasonable call, but the required behavior is still absent: it only said it would write them later.

assertions.text: Writes TRACE_MATRIX.md from the template and runs scripts/check_knowledge_links.py.

judge.reason: The agent didn't write TRACE_MATRIX.md and didn't run scripts/check_knowledge_links.py. No files were changed, and its tool calls show only greps and reads.
